description_zh: 查询站点的压缩规则详情
name: GetCompressionRule

parameters.help_en: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html interface
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: Configuration ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2867498.html interface
parameters.name: config_id

Brotli.description_en:
Brotli compression. Possible values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
Brotli.description_zh:
Brotli压缩。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

ConfigType.description_en:
Configuration type. Possible values:
global: Global configuration.
rule: Rule-based configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型。取值范围：
global：全局配置。
rule：规则配置

Gzip.description_en:
Gzip compression. Possible values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
Gzip.description_zh:
Gzip压缩。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Rule.description_en:
Rule content, using conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Possible values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: Rule execution order. The smaller the value, the higher the priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, this parameter can specify the effective version of the configuration, defaulting to version 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0

Zstd.description_en:
Zstd compression. Value range: 
on: enabled. 
off: disabled
Zstd.description_zh:
Zstd压缩。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
